notes: Run of 2026-11-17. Two Chronicle posts queued. The 475 Sansome lease is declined because its headline names a person; the Muni upgrades story names no address.

findings.description: OpenAI's hardware team leased a large office at 475 Sansome St.

citation.label: San Francisco Chronicle, “Exclusive: OpenAI and Jony Ive’s secretive AI hardware team just leased a huge S.F. office,” 16 November 2026

publish.note: The headline names a person who is not an architect, builder, developer or firm (Jony Ive), and a headline may not be edited, so it cannot go on a page. The Registry's same-day account (2026-11-17-rg-0001) has the same problem. A big lease is otherwise the kind of fact this module publishes (precedent: 201 Mission, 2026-11-07-hl-0001); a later story on this lease with a usable headline would carry it.

resolution.method: EAS exact match on 475 SANSOME ST → parcel 0228038; sf-parcels has blklot 0228038 active, 475–475 SANSOME; the 2025 roll records it as commercial office, built 1900.
resolution.note: No page at this path yet; the parcel is the publisher's to seed.
